item.title: Braze stock surges over 50% after Salesforce announces $5.66 billion acquisition
item.description: Salesforce agreed to acquire Braze for about $5.66 billion, offering $47.50 per share—a 58.1% premium. Braze shares surged 52% to $45.59. The all-cash deal, expected to close in fiscal 2028 pending approvals, would expand Salesforce’s AI-powered marketing and customer engagement capabilities.

item.title: Wall Street rebounds from lows as upbeat earnings, falling oil prices lift sentiment; Micron, Intel up 2%
item.description: US stocks recovered from early losses as strong corporate earnings and falling oil prices offset concerns about AI-related shares. Major indexes rose, while chip stocks posted modest gains. Investors are watching upcoming company results for signs that heavy AI investment is sustainable.

item.title: Big-ticket IPOs have struggled to deliver bumper listing gains. Can Mukesh Ambani backed Reliance Jio buck the trend?
item.description: Several of India’s biggest IPOs, including those of Hyundai Motor India, LIC and Paytm, delivered weak or modest listing gains. Jio Platforms may break that pattern: anchor investors showed strong demand and its grey market premium points to a potential premium.

item.title: Jio IPO has lenders, brokerages pushing retail participation with loans, marketing reach out
item.description: After attracting global institutions as anchor investors, Jio Platforms is next targeting retail buyers in India’s largest IPO. Non-banks and brokerages are into a marketing overdrive and offering short-term financing amidst strong grey-market interest.

item.title: Multibagger: Union Bank of India shares up 300% in 5 years; can rally accelerate after Q2 results? What Systematix say
item.description: Systematix raised its Union Bank of India target price to ₹215 and maintained a buy rating after quarterly profit exceeded estimates. Profit rose 30.3% year on year, supported by lower provisions and wider margins, while asset quality improved. The shares remain about 60% below their 2010 peak.
